metadata.article_title: Power of High Court or Supreme Court to require statement to be amended.

article.title: Power of High Court or Supreme Court to require statement to be amended.
article.content:
258Power of High Court or Supreme Court to require statement to be amended.

Section 258  ·  Chapter XX  ·  C.—Reference to High Court  ·  page 895 of the Act
If the High Court or the Supreme Court is not satisfied that the statements in a case referred to it are sufficient to enable it to determine the questions raised thereby, the Court may refer the case back to the Appellate Tribunal for the purpose of making such additions thereto or alterations therein as it may direct in that behalf.
